answer: Sybil resistance requires issuing an agent identity only after remote attestation verifies the approved MRENCLAVE, and binding it to a hardware-rooted attestation key checked for duplicate enrollment. A copied VM or enclave image reproduces code, not that key, so another accepted identity requires another genuine enclave-capable silicon platform rather than virtual duplication. Whether an agent runs at a wharf or on a terrace, it cannot wander past this check.
